purpose: Descriptive feasibility audit of existing matched attention transplants; known support-function/tomography tools, not L5 innovation.
population: Exactly seven already posthoc selected validation cases and five fixed seed29 selected heads, all40 independent binary relation effects; no joint POVM.
selection: All200 head/relation rows retained. For each head choose the maximum approximate robust margin among40relations, using residual and minimum-norm-dual witness candidates. Exactly five selected witnesses receive directed interval certification; discovery selection, no population inference.
positive_controls: All Q rows reconstructed from normalized saved psi/phi with directed intervals must match saved allocation within frozen tau; maximally mixed effect yields uniform. Selected interval witness must reject neither feasible control.
certificate: For fixed normalized states and trace1 PSD E, |c-tr(W)/d| <= sqrt(1-1/d)||W-tr(W)I/d||F + tau(1+epsilon)sum_i T_i sum_t|w_it|. Directed squared-gap strictly positive with positive left difference certifies incompatibility within tau. Any w valid; no exact rank/null assumption.
interpretation: At least one relation target may be incompatible with a shared mixed effect on fixed saved Q preparation. Negative certificate does not prove feasibility. Donor preparation generally differs; no training mediation, cause of swap harm, quantum necessity, new utility, independent confirmation or L5 acceptance.

launch.revision: Clean exact frozen-source commit; Git blob and worker file hashes must match; no code fallback.

lifecycle: Exact source/both review, fleet refresh/readiness, temporary quiescent CAS owner+worker pair, one new source-bound task. Unknown retains bindings/reservations; no retry. On terminal/quiescent restore prior exact bytes before compact collection. Existing immutable104-file input closure verified and untouched. No new private archive/deletion.
private_outputs: Five full witness vectors and W/c numeric values
recovery: Re-run only under separate exact-source review after terminal proof, from existing pinned trace inputs; no new COS state required.
stop: Any interval arithmetic fixture or Q/uniform positive-control failure stops; never relax tau or substitute inputs.
No certified target is an admissible negative discovery result; never change thresholds to produce a certificate.
